finding_dispositions.evidence: Fresh evidence rebuild/replay, 113-test full suite and 4-test WP-01 cross suite passed, and r15 now emits schema/canonical/digest/GEEL work with exact budget rejection. However, operation-frame sequencing remains non-normative: an independent GraphDefinition.create trace contained four top-level schema.instance_visit occurrences at operation_path=[] while canonical roots were [9] and [40] and digest roots [10] and [41], because nested schema validation consumed root child ordinals. Exact cross-implementation operation paths are not tested.
Fresh r15 schema regressions passed Draft 2020-12 annotation propagation across applicators and closed references.
Fresh r15 predicate and executable-binding regressions passed; graph, completion, join and loop evaluation use exact PredicateRegistry-backed GEEL programs and accept no callable input.
Fresh r15 ErrorRuleRegistry regressions passed exact digest-locked code/phase/rule enforcement, and all added GEEL loaders require the exact registry.
Fresh r15 migration regressions passed exact schema pins, unique paths, frozen implementation binding, charged output/provenance and byte-identical provenance.
Fresh independent Node execution passed all four WP-01 cross suites including GEW-CON-001 through GEW-CON-250; the fresh full suite also passed the two added WP-02 independent graph/GEEL comparisons.

Fresh immutable-model and enum frozen-tuple regressions passed; added graph, policy, budget and snapshot instances copy/freeze nested input and reject ordinary direct construction where factory loading is required.

The r15 command evidence matches both governing documents by path, size and SHA-256; their independently recomputed ordered canonical digest is 22a4b54d29f18d5289c326167c612a049058b6118abe2917b5a4d7b4fc70edb0, and the exit record binds it. Fresh source-manifest verification and full evidence rebuild/replay passed.

GraphDefinition and TaskSnapshot now use registered source/digest-input schema pairs whose structural diff is checked at runtime, and charged creation/verification uses the digest-input schema ID. Policy and loop registries are schema-validated identity contracts. Independent probes rejected a 65-character policy version, a kind/condition mismatch, direct constructors, and graph policy/budget registry swaps.
Completion, join and loop-budget decisions now compile to GEELProgram and require WorkContext during evaluation. Fresh boundary tests and independent Node truth-table comparisons passed.

findings.claim: Charged graph and snapshot projection paths still violate the ADR-0003 recursive child-operation path model.
findings.evidence: ClosedSchemaRegistry.validate cannot receive an operation_path and always starts at []. The charged self-digest helpers invoke source/input validators without allocating child frames, while semantic_digest_charged allocates from the same root. GraphDefinition.create then invokes full from_dict verification again in the same context. The observed create trace had four schema operation roots at [] and canonical/digest roots [9]/[10] and [40]/[41], rather than isolated children assigned by actual child-call order. Current tests assert event presence and aggregate budget only; the Node test compares result/digest, not the trace.
findings.required_change: Give every nested validate/canonicalize/digest operation an explicit parent operation path and allocate its child ordinal exactly at the call site. Refactor graph creation so semantic validation does not repeat an un-nested verification operation. Add byte-exact golden traces asserting every event_ordinal and operation_path for GraphDefinition create/load and TaskSnapshot create/restore, plus independent implementation equality and budget cutoffs at each emitted occurrence.

findings.claim: GraphDefinition and TaskSnapshot do not exact-pin the complete contract/resource context required for deterministic load and replay.
findings.evidence: GraphDefinition pins five registries but no ResourceProfile or CostSchedule identity/body digest. The same graph digest loaded successfully under two schedules and consumed 15188 versus 15911 work units. TaskSnapshot contains no schema-registry, ResourceProfile or CostSchedule pin. The identical snapshot_digest restored successfully under schema registry graph-kernel digest sha256-jcs-v1:89e8ff766cb1b86c5c81312021b9cbbaaedbea7e2bb98afd8f43aa7b0cccdc77 and a graph-test registry with an extra rogue resource digest sha256-jcs-v1:2cb77b5ae935cbd52690cf7bf9f512337c2ec2377f9b05540b0fedba7a9256da. It also restored under an altered CostSchedule while retaining the same digest. ADR-0003 requires the task/record to exact-pin IDs, body digests and the complete registry manifest, and states that GraphDefinition retains graph/profile/schema/registry refs.
findings.required_change: Add the exact schema-registry ID/digest, ResourceProfile ID/body digest, CostSchedule ID/body digest and other required contract-stack pins to the graph/task semantic records and their source/digest-input schemas. Include the graph semantic digest in GraphRef or an equivalently exact bound reference. Compare supplied registries/profile/schedule against those pins before validation, evaluation or replay. Add rejection tests for unrelated registry additions, same-ID manifest changes, altered schedule coefficients/profile limits and graph content drift, and bind all pin fields into independent digest vectors.
